summary: iter363 'Aged Canvas' light-theme retheme verified across homepage, /shop, PDP, /makers, /pricing, /apply, footer, and dark mode toggle. All warm-palette tokens render correctly (paper #ECE6DA, copper #B76437, charcoal footer #2D2B28). Dark mode untouched (#121212 + #F97316). Hero headline copy updated to 'Built by Makers. Crafted to Last.' Trending strip badges render. Two non-theming regressions surfaced: an Axios 404 runtime-error dev overlay on some navigations and an unverified PDP 'Back to shop' selector.

ui_bugs.issue: Uncaught runtime errors overlay shown with multiple 'Request failed with status code 404' AxiosErrors after navigation (e.g., between makers/pricing). Origin appears to be an XHR to a missing endpoint. Not theme-related but breaks visual flow during testing.

A queried price element resolved to color rgb(255,255,255) on transparent background. Likely a badge sitting over an image, but worth confirming there is no white-on-cream price text on product cards in light mode.

integration_issues.issue: Could not locate a 'Back to shop' anchor on /shop/active-project-4?ref=trending (no <a> with text containing 'back to shop'). Spec requires href to be /shop?sort=best_selling when ref=trending. Selector / visibility needs verification.

Exact-match query a[href='/shop/active-project-4?ref=trending'] returned no element, though [data-testid='trending-tile-0-views'] badge is present. Link likely exists with a different href format (e.g., wrapping <a> on a parent). Main agent should confirm hrefs match the spec exactly.

action_items: Investigate the Axios 404 runtime-error overlay surfacing during navigation (likely a missing /api endpoint hit on mount of /makers or /pricing). Identify which network call returns 404 and either guard it or fix the endpoint.
Verify PDP 'Back to shop' link is rendered, has correct text/aria-label, and href = /shop?sort=best_selling when ?ref=trending is in URL.
Confirm trending tile <a> hrefs exactly match /shop/active-project-4?ref=trending in markup.
Spot-check product-card price color in light mode to ensure no white-on-cream text.
critical_code_review_comments: Hero.jsx headline values use mixed case but .font-display applies text-transform: uppercase — visible text is correctly 'BUILT BY MAKERS. CRAFTED TO LAST.'. No change needed.
Footer.jsx scopes cm-footer-dark via token override (good — DRY). Spec colors all verified at runtime.
index.css iter363 block cleanly redefines tokens within html:not(.dark) scope, leaving dark mode tokens intact — clean approach.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (theming 100%, two minor regressions outside CSS scope)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Theme retheme verified via runtime computed-style checks. If retesting, use viewport 1920x1080 and check html.dark presence after clicking the moon/sun toggle in <header>. The cookie consent banner appears at bottom — accept it first. Don't rely on case-sensitive innerText assertions for hero h1 (it is uppercased by CSS). Trending strip lives on the homepage below the hero; tile 0 view-badge testid is trending-tile-0-views. The PDP at /shop/active-project-4?ref=trending should expose a 'Back to shop' link whose href reads /shop?sort=best_selling.
rca_of_the_issue: Axios 404 overlay — needs network panel inspection to identify the failing endpoint; not caused by this retheme iteration but visible during testing. PDP back-link / trending href mismatches are likely just selector/format differences and should be confirmed in source by the main agent.
